## Business context

Product managers and business stakeholders spent a large part of every week **pulling data from several platforms by hand and reformatting it in Excel** for routine reports. The process was repetitive and error-prone. It also limited how deeply teams could analyze anything, because most of their time went to gathering data rather than interpreting it.

## My role

- Identified the reporting gap: the same datasets and calculations were being rebuilt manually every cycle
- Mapped the existing workflows and wrote the specification (data sources, business logic, output format)
- Partnered with the engineering and BI teams to design the automated SQL pipelines and Tableau dashboards, then drove adoption across stakeholder teams

## Analytical approach

The goal was not "build a dashboard." It was to **remove repeated manual work**, which meant first finding out exactly what was being repeated.

::: {.flow}
::: {.flow-step}
**Map current workflows**
[who pulls what, how often]{.small}
:::
::: {.flow-step}
**Find the repeats**
[shared datasets and calculations]{.small}
:::
::: {.flow-step .accent}
**Write the spec**
[sources, logic, output]{.small}
:::
::: {.flow-step}

[SQL pipelines + Tableau]{.small}
:::
::: {.flow-step}
**Roll out and adopt**
[20+ stakeholders]{.small}
:::
:::

## Visual explanation

**From manual reporting to a single, always-current view**

::: {.compare}
::: {}
[Before]{.compare-title}

1. Extract data from several platforms
2. Reformat it in Excel
3. Recalculate the same KPIs by hand
4. Send a static report
5. Repeat every week
:::
::: {.after}
[After]{.compare-title}

1. Automated SQL pipelines refresh the data
2. KPI logic is defined once, centrally
3. One Tableau dashboard shows current status
4. Stakeholders serve themselves, in real time
5. Analyst time goes to interpretation
:::
:::

## Business impact

- Saved about **20 team-hours per month**, roughly 30 minutes a week for each of about 20 people
- Gave **20+ stakeholders** real-time KPI monitoring and status reporting instead of weekly static reports
- Built a habit of **data accessibility**: teams that used to depend on manual extracts began using data in their day-to-day decisions
- Grew out of the reporting needs identified in the [Official Account pricing work](../line-oa-lifecycle-pricing/index.qmd)
